findings.summary: The run is recorded in a finally block, so a run that raises or is closed early is stored as if it were complete and later calls replay the partial result.
cache_clear() resets the generation to 0 instead of advancing it, so a run that was under way when the cache was cleared still records its result.
Keyword arguments are appended to the key without a marker, so f(1, ('b', 2)) and f(1, b=2) share a recording.

replay() treats an empty recording as no recording, but record() stores a run that produced nothing as an empty list, so a function whose run yields no items is called again on every call instead of being replayed.
